name: Dr Daniel Bradshaw
title: Senior Clinical Fellow
info: Dan Bradshaw is a consultant in the Virus Reference Department, National Infection Service, Public Health England. He trained as a sexual health physician before undertaking a post-CCT fellowship in virology at PHE, where he supported the clinical validation of the HCV whole genome sequencing pipeline. His research interests include HIV/HCV coinfection.

name: Dr Tamyo Mbisa
title: Head of Antiviral Unit
info: Tamyo Mbisa is Head of the Antiviral Unit within the Virus Reference Department at Public Health England. His research interests include mechanisms of antiviral resistance, molecular epidemiology, virus-host interactions and the development of novel sequencing methods. He also co-ordinates the UK HIV Resistance Network of NHS laboratories undertaking genotypic antiviral resistance testing.

name: Professor John McLauchlan
title: Professor of Viral Hepatitis
affiliation: MRC University of Glasgow Centre for Virus Research
info: Prof McLauchlan leads a research group investigating viral hepatitis. He is also a co-Chair of HCV Research UK and a collaborator in the STOP-HCV consortium.

name: Dr Emma Thomson
title: Clinical Senior Lecturer
affiliation: MRC University of Glasgow Centre for Virus Research
info: Dr Thomson leads a research group investigating viral Hepatitis and the ecology and evolution of emerging virus infections. She holds a Wellcome Trust fellowship relating to T-cell mediated evolution of HCV during acute infection and is also a collaborator in the STOP-HCV consortium.

name: Dr Sandeep Kasaragod
title: Bioinformatician
affiliation: School of Biodiversity, Animal Health & Comparative Medicine
info: Dr. Kasaragod is a Bioinformatician, he is passionate about working on genome sequencing data analysis. He works majorly on the development of the workflow and tools to support the virus research.
